test_results.question: What is the average MRR across all recorded plans?
test_results.generated_sql: SELECT "plan_tier", ROUND(AVG("mrr_usd"), 2) AS avg_mrr_usd FROM "clean_saas_metrics" GROUP BY "plan_tier" ORDER BY avg_mrr_usd DESC LIMIT 50

test_results.question: What is the correlation between mrr and active_users?
test_results.generated_sql: SELECT AVG(clean_saas_metrics.mrr_usd) AS mrr_avg, COUNT(CASE WHEN clean_saas_metrics.is_active THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS active_users FROM clean_saas_metrics WHERE clean_saas_metrics.is_active = TRUE LIMIT 500

test_results.question: Are there any extreme outliers in quantity_returned?
test_results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS outlier_count FROM dirty_ecommerce_returns WHERE ABS(quantity_returned) > (SELECT QUANTILE_CONT(ABS(quantity_returned), 0.99 ORDER BY ABS(quantity_returned)) FROM dirty_ecommerce_returns) LIMIT 500

test_results.question: Forecast the MRR growth trend for the next 3 months
test_results.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(mrr_usd) AS mrr_growth
FROM 
    clean_saas_metrics
WHERE 
    is_active = TRUE
GROUP BY 
    MONTH(signup_date)
ORDER BY 
    MONTH(signup_date)
LIMIT 3;

test_results.question: Which product category has the highest total quantity_returned?
test_results.generated_sql:
SELECT 
  product_category,
  SUM(quantity_returned) AS result_metric
FROM 
  dirty_ecommerce_returns
GROUP BY 
  product_category
ORDER BY 
  result_metric DESC
LIMIT 1;
